speaker: Sheldon
text: Noise] Penny. I can't sleep.

speaker: Penny
text: What? Maybe that's because your hole is still open.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm homesick.

speaker: Penny
text: Your home is twenty feet from here.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Twenty feet, twenty light years, doesn't matter. In a galaxy far, far away.

speaker: Penny
text: What do you want me to do?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sing soft, kitty.

speaker: Penny
text: That's only for when you're sick.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Homesick is a type of being sick.

speaker: Penny
text: Come on, do I really have to?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Suppose we can stay up and talk.

speaker: Penny
text: Soft kitty, warm kitty, little ball of fur, happy kitty.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sleepy kitty. No. Start over.

speaker: Penny
text: Sleepy kitty.

speaker: Penny
text: Happy kitty, sleepy kitty, purr.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Penny. Thank you for letting me stay here.

speaker: Penny
text: Yeah.

speaker: Penny
text: You're welcome, sweetie.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Okay, I'm sleepy now, get out.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, we had dinner, played some games, and then I spent the night. Oh, you'll be happy to know that I now have a much better understanding of friends with benefits.
